implementation_notes.committee_computation: Off-chain local computation calling committee-service functions: (1) additive secret sharing (n-of-n, not Shamir), (2) plaintext reconstruction + sort.Slice + AP_buy >= AP_sell comparison (not oblivious sort or secure comparison), (3) settlement Δ/FP/CS update, (4) ECDSA P-256+SHA256 signing by 3 nodes. 30 orders per run.
implementation_notes.finalization: Fabric invoke SubmitMatchingResult with --waitForEvent. Includes Docker exec IPC + TLS + peer endorsement + orderer ordering + block commit + event delivery. Chaincode performs: idempotency check, threshold signature check (base64 format + count >= 2; NOT full ECDSA cryptographic verification), computation verification (trivially passes for empty pairs), writes MatchingResult state to ledger.
implementation_notes.membership_verification: Fabric query VerifyMembershipProof. Chaincode loads RSA accumulator state from CouchDB and computes witness^H(userID) mod N (real 1024-bit RSA modexp). witnessA = accumulator A value; verification returns false (invalid witness) but compute cost identical to valid verification. Prototype limitation: AccumulatorState does not persist per-user witnesses.
implementation_notes.preprocessing: Local HMAC-SHA256 batch proof via order-service preprocessing.GenerateBatchProofWithPhaseTimings(). Not a zero-knowledge proof; provides integrity verification only.
implementation_notes.submission: Fabric invoke CreateBuyOrder with --waitForEvent. Includes Docker exec IPC + TLS + peer endorsement + orderer ordering + block commit + event delivery.
implementation_notes.throughput: Complete workflow throughput. Each 'transaction' is a complete variant workflow, not just a single Fabric invoke.
implementation_notes.total_latency_method: Wall-clock elapsed time from workflowStart to workflowEnd for each run. NOT the arithmetic sum of per-stage averages.

results.measurement_scope: True workflow measurement. Each run executes the variant's complete workflow sequentially (Submission→Finalization). Total latency is the real wall-clock elapsed time from workflowStart to workflowEnd. Submission=Fabric invoke CreateBuyOrder (--waitForEvent: endorsement+ordering+commit+event). Finalization=Fabric invoke SubmitMatchingResult (--waitForEvent: endorsement+ordering+commit+event). Both include Docker exec IPC overhead.
results.implementation_note: Enabled stages: Submission + Finalization(SubmitMatchingResult). Chaincode SubmitMatchingResult: idempotency check + base64 format + threshold count check (not full ECDSA verification) + state write.
